name: Adelaide University STEM Higher Education Opportunity Scholarship
summary: $3,000 a year for equity-group students in Engineering, IT or Science programs, including women in non-traditional areas.
key: $3,000 per year for the duration of the program.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen
Enrolled in an eligible program in the College of Engineering and Information Technology or the College of Science
Member of a recognised equity group, such as First Nations, low socioeconomic background or women in non-traditional areas
how: Online applications via myScholarships with a written statement of up to 500 words
catches: 2026 applications opened 19 January and closed 15 March 2026; check for the next round
Not available to students who have received another Adelaide University STEM scholarship
